findings.issue: `periodGroupComparison_sphere_bijective` repeats the same argument in kernel form: it decomposes `s = k • [S²]` and uses `zsmul_sphereGenerator_injective` to force `k = 0`, which is the same injectivity fact restricted to spherical classes.

summary: Proofs are short and mostly robust, but two bijectivity theorems on the sphere each re-derive inline the same hidden fact, injectivity of `ofSingularHomology` on `H₂(S²; ℤ)`, which the docstrings claim as an isomorphism `H₂(S²; ℤ) ≅ Γ` without stating it as a lemma.
